name: cadara
author: Dimitris Zervas <dzervas@dzervas.gr>

scripts.build:single: bun run typecheck && vite build --config vite.single.config.ts
scripts.landing:models:build: bun landing/scripts/build-bracket.ts && bun landing/scripts/build-wheel.ts && bun landing/scripts/build-enclosure.ts
scripts.test:logic: vitest run --project fast --project isolated src/contracts src/core src/domain src/application src/infrastructure/import src/infrastructure/modeling src/infrastructure/occ src/infrastructure/persistence src/infrastructure/workers
scripts.test:ui: vitest run --project fast --project isolated src/workbench src/components src/hooks src/lib src/infrastructure/section-view src/infrastructure/viewport
scripts.test:e2e:offline: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN= vite build --config vite.offline-test.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.offline.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:real-captures: bun ./scripts/require-onshape-captures.ts && PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_CAPTURES=1 playwright test e2e/onshape-import-parametric.spec.ts e2e/onshape-variable-rebuild.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:real-captures:diagnostic: bun ./scripts/require-onshape-captures.ts && PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_CAPTURES=1 PLAYWRIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS=1 playwright test e2e/onshape-import-parametric.spec.ts e2e/onshape-variable-rebuild.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:all: bun run test:e2e && bun run test:e2e:real-captures
scripts.test:all: bun run lint && bun run build && bun run typecheck:specs && bun run test && bun run test:heavy && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:all:acceptance: bun run lint && bun run build && bun run typecheck:specs && bun run test && bun run test:heavy:acceptance && bun run test:e2e:all

//: @playwright/test is pinned exactly: keep it equal to pkgs.playwright-driver.version from devenv.lock (devenv supplies the matching browsers via PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH and warns on mismatch). Without devenv, run `bunx playwright install chromium`.
